name: Systemic sclerosis — skin and Raynaud's care
dx: Systemic sclerosis — skin and Raynaud's care
advice: Keep whole body warm, wear gloves and socks, avoid cold water and smoking. Check BP at home weekly — sudden high BP, headache or less urine is an emergency (renal crisis). Tests: ANA, anti-Scl-70, anti-centromere, creatinine, urine, ECG, echo, PFT/HRCT. Rheumatology co-management for skin thickening/organ involvement.
